messages:
deploy-bot: Planned canary: service=llm-router image=redwood/llm-router:v2.6.0. Feature-flag rollout: llm_dynamic_routing_enable -> shadow-probe (no user traffic) for 30m, then soak cohorts 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over 3h if metrics stable. Change window 01:00-05:00 UTC. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1807777777. @adele @mike

adele: FYI staging replay showed an embedding p95 shift (~+14%) when routing path changed. Not user facing in shadow run but want to understand source before impacting live traffic.

mike: please keep the initial mode as shadow-probe only (collect traces and traces-only metrics). don't flip user traffic until QA signs off.

ops-ash: switched planned rollout to shadow-probe flag state and paused automated ramp. Logged: "shadow probe only - awaiting trace analysis" :mag:

qa-lin: running a targeted shadow replay with sampling ON (100% capture) against v2.6.0. capturing embedding latency by model shard. ETA ~18m.

sam: if shadow metrics look clean we still want a tiny soak cohort (0.5%) rather than jumping straight to 2% — this app is sensitive to microbursts. Also suggest enabling temporary burst-attenuator in rollout config.

adele: agreed. add burst-attenuator: max-inflight-per-replica=8 and ramp soaks 0.5% -> 2% -> 10%. Also add automatic abort policy: abort if embedding p95 > baseline +7% for 12m or error-rate > 0.3%.

ops-ash: safety gates configured on rollout: embedding-p95-gate and error-rate-gate. Shadow-probe remains active. Notified stakeholders and support.

qa-lin: shadow replay done. Findings: embedding p95 increased on two specific routing paths (path-A and path-C) by ~18% and 22% in sample traces. Attaching trace ids. No increase in error-rate.

mike: path-C uses a new quantized kernel we enabled in this build. could be quantization-induced slowdown on certain sequence lengths. can we toggle quant-kernel to the previous fallback for path-C in rollout config and re-run shadow?

sam: yes, create a staged config override per-route: keep path-C using legacy-kernel, keep others on new kernel. That should be a quick mitigant without a full rollback.

adele: make that change in rollout config and re-run shadow. keep flag in shadow mode. if shadow passes, proceed to 0.5% soak and closely watch embedding p95 by route. rollback plan ready if needed.

ops-ash: applying per-route kernel override in rollout config and re-running shadow. Pause remains. Logs: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1807777777/overrides

qa-lin: second shadow replay results: path-C p95 back within baseline +3%, path-A still shows +10% (below abort threshold but worth tracking). recommend start conservative soak: 0.5% for 30m then 2% for 60m with route-aware metrics.

sam: confirm start soak plan. Keep runbook at hand:
```
# pin previous stable if we need to abort
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-router --version v2.5.8 --reason "canary regressions"
# abort deploy queue
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 1807777777
```

adele: release-note draft for PMs: "Canary started in shadow-probe mode; per-route kernel override applied after shadow replay; proceeding to conservative soak cohorts with burst attenuation and safety gates. No user impact so far."

ops-ash: starting manual soak cohort: llm_dynamic_routing_enable=0.5% now for canaries. Burst-attenuator active. Monitoring dashboards pinned. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary update recorded: state=soak-0.5% started by ops-ash. Automated increments are disabled; manual approval required for next step. Aborts will trigger pin and deploy abort commands.

qa-lin: first 30m of soak: embedding p95 stable within +4% overall; path-A still at +9% but no errors. Holding at 0.5% for another 15m before advancing.

sam: good. once we hit 2% we should enable a short-lived synthetic traffic spike to validate burst behavior. If any safety gate fires, execute rollback commands above.

adele: noted. Keep thread open until final roll-forward or rollback. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
